SICC.why: SiC substrate maker: its conductive and semi-insulating SiC substrates are the starting material of SiC power devices, so SiC power-semiconductor demand drives its sales
SICC.evidence: SICC investor Q&A (09-14-2026): the company says silicon carbide is its core product and it continues technical cooperation and product deliveries with leading global optics customers

players.product: Silicon carbide (SiC) substrates: conductive, semi-insulating and P-type (6/8-inch volume, 12-inch launched); also optical-grade SiC for micro-nano optics

quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SSE e-Interactive that it continues technical cooperation and product deliveries with leading global optics customers in micro-nano optics and is pushing product iteration and downstream customer adoption; downstream applications of optical-grade SiC are still at an early stage of demand release, a volume ramp will take time and the timing of meaningful revenue cannot yet be predicted. It said SiC remains its core product and it is researching other new semiconductor materials.
